planets.name: WASP-132 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-132 with a 1.01-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: WASP-132 c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around WASP-132. Its orbit and size follow Grieves et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
